questions.q: Which seafaring raiders came from Sweden and its neighbours around 800–1050?
questions.why: Swedish Vikings travelled east into Russia.

questions.q: Which warship sank on its first voyage in 1628?
questions.why: It was raised in 1961 and is now a museum.

questions.q: Which king led Sweden in the Thirty Years' War?
questions.why: He died at the Battle of Lützen in 1632.

questions.q: Who has been King of Sweden since 1973?
questions.why: His daughter Victoria is heir.

questions.q: Which king founded modern Sweden after leaving the Kalmar Union in 1523?
questions.why: 6 June, National Day, marks his election.

questions.q: Which Swedish diplomat saved thousands of Jews in Budapest in 1944?
questions.why: He disappeared in Soviet custody.

questions.q: Which Swedish UN Secretary-General died in a 1961 plane crash?
questions.why: He was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize after his death.

questions.q: Which Prime Minister was assassinated in Stockholm in 1986?
questions.why: The case was officially closed in 2020.

questions.q: Which French marshal became King of Sweden as Charles XIV John?
questions.why: The royal family descends from him.

questions.q: Which king lost the Battle of Poltava to Russia in 1709?
questions.why: It ended Sweden's time as a great power.

questions.q: Which teenage climate activist began school strikes in 2018?
questions.why: She began outside the Swedish parliament.

questions.q: What is the capital of Sweden?
questions.why: It is built on 14 islands.

questions.q: Which Swedish band won Eurovision in 1974 with 'Waterloo'?
questions.why: They became one of the best-selling bands ever.

questions.q: Which Swedish DJ made 'Wake Me Up' and 'Levels'?
questions.why: He was born Tim Bergling.

questions.q: Which Swedish director made 'The Seventh Seal'?
questions.why: Death plays chess with a knight in it.

questions.q: Which Swedish author created Pippi Longstocking?
questions.why: Pippi first appeared in 1945.

questions.q: Which writer was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.why: She won in 1909.

questions.q: In which year did Sweden join NATO?
questions.why: It had been neutral for about 200 years.

questions.q: Which Swedish botanist created the system of naming species?
questions.why: He gave us names like Homo sapiens.

questions.q: Which Swedish inventor of dynamite founded the Nobel Prizes?
questions.why: He left his fortune for the prizes.

questions.q: Which Swedish astronomer created a temperature scale?
questions.why: Water boils at 100 degrees on his scale.

questions.q: Which furniture company with flat-pack furniture is Swedish?
questions.why: It was founded in 1943.

questions.q: Which midsummer tradition involves dancing around a pole?
questions.why: People wear flower crowns.

questions.q: Which meatballs are served with lingonberry jam?
questions.why: They are often eaten with mashed potato.

questions.q: What is Sweden's currency?
questions.why: Sweden voted not to adopt the euro.

questions.q: Which hotel is rebuilt every winter from ice in Jukkasjärvi?
questions.why: It was the world's first ice hotel.

questions.q: Which saint's day on 13 December features candle crowns?
questions.why: A girl leads a procession wearing candles.

questions.q: Which Swedish car brand is known for safety?
questions.why: It invented the modern three-point seatbelt.

questions.q: What is the Swedish coffee-and-cake break called?
questions.why: It is a daily habit.

questions.q: Which indigenous people live in northern Sweden?
questions.why: Many herd reindeer.
